what_works: A limited color palette with a primary blue accent against neutral backgrounds creates clear visual hierarchy.
System fonts and variable sans-serif typefaces provide a clean typographic hierarchy with mono accents for technical elements.
Precise spacing defined in pixels (1‑4 px) yields a spacious, airy layout that enhances readability.
Consistent 8 px corner radius on UI components gives a soft, contemporary feel while maintaining structure.
Balanced density of interactive components (clickables, tabs, carousels) with ample whitespace ensures usability.
